question: What is the volumetric mean radius of Earth, in kilometers?
source_note: NASA Earth Fact Sheet (NSSDCA, pre-2026 standard): volumetric mean radius = 6,371.0 km.

question: What is the IAU 2015 nominal effective surface temperature of the Sun, in kelvins?
source_note: IAU 2015 Resolution B3 nominal solar conversion constants: T_eff,N = 5,772 K.

question: What is the mean center-to-center distance (orbital semi-major axis) from Earth to the Moon, in kilometers?
source_note: NASA Moon Fact Sheet (NSSDCA, pre-2026 standard): semi-major axis (mean distance from Earth) = 384,400 km.

question: What is the revised Cambridge physical radioactive half-life of Carbon-14 recognized since 1962, in years?
source_note: Godwin, H. (1962), Nature 195:984, Fifth Radiocarbon Dating Conference (Cambridge): physical 14C half-life = 5,730 years.

question: According to the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM), what is the depth from Earth's surface to the core-mantle boundary, in kilometers?
source_note: Dziewonski & Anderson (1981), Physics of the Earth and Planetary Interiors 25:297-356 (PREM): CMB depth = 2,891 km.

question: What is Earth's sidereal rotation period (one full rotation relative to the fixed stars), in seconds?
source_note: NASA Earth Fact Sheet (NSSDCA): sidereal rotation period = 23.9345 h = 86,164 s (integer-second standard).

question: What is the standard melting point of pure metallic tungsten at atmospheric pressure, in degrees Celsius?
source_note: NIST / CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics standard reference: melting point of tungsten (W) = 3,422 degrees Celsius.

question: What is the main suspension span length of the 1915 Canakkale Bridge in Turkey, the world's longest suspension bridge span, in meters?
source_note: Turkish General Directorate of Highways (KGM, 2022 completion): 1915 Canakkale Bridge main span = 2,023 meters.

question: What is the maximum vertical drilling depth reached by the Kola Superdeep Borehole (SG-3) on the Kola Peninsula, in meters?
source_note: Kola Superdeep Borehole (SG-3, 1989 record depth): deepest vertical artificial crustal borehole = 12,262 meters.

question: What is the total nameplate hydroelectric generating capacity of Hoover Dam in the United States, in megawatts?
source_note: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation Lower Colorado Region specifications: Hoover Dam nameplate capacity = 2,080 MW.

question: What was the main spherical reflector dish diameter of the Arecibo Observatory radio telescope in Puerto Rico, in meters?
source_note: National Science Foundation (NSF) / Cornell NAIC Arecibo Observatory specifications: spherical reflector diameter = 305 meters.

question: What is the canonical sequence length (highest numbered base-pair coordinate) of the human mitochondrial genome in the revised Cambridge Reference Sequence (rCRS), in base pairs?
source_note: Andrews et al. (1999), Nature Genetics 23:147 / NCBI GenBank NC_012920 (rCRS): canonical sequence coordinate length = 16,569 bp.
